chunks: And by his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him) who said:
‘And those Foremost (in Faith) will be Foremost (in the Hereafter)...’ was revealed about him.

He (peace be upon him) said regarding the words of the Exalted, the Glorious: ‘These will be the heirs, who will inherit Paradise: they will dwell therein (forever).’ [the verse] was revealed about him.
ai.seo_question: Which Quranic verses were revealed specifically about Imam Ali (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Imam Ali (a.s.) explicitly identifies himself as the referent for the 'Foremost' (Al-Sabiqun) in Surah Al-Waqi'ah and the 'Heirs of Paradise' in Surah Al-Mu'minun, establishing his unique spiritual precedence. This attribution underscores the Shia doctrine of Imamate, linking the Ahl al-Bayt's inherent purity and leadership directly to the promise of eternal inheritance in the highest levels of Jannah.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-289 According to the same documentation, it is narrated that Ali (a.s.) said, “
The following verse was revealed about me, ‘And those Foremost (in Faith) will be Foremost (in the Hereafter).’
He said the same thing about what the Honorable the Exalted God’s said, ‘These will be the heirs, who will inherit Paradise: they will dwell therein (forever).’
